# Standard

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A documented specification, format, or set of rules established by a recognized body, intended for consistent, repeated use.

## Scope note

Parent concept for ISOStandard and W3CStandard, and for related individual standards such as SKOS, OWL, and RDF.
